# Paper red/blue exercise scope and findings
Authoriser: teacher for this classroom paper activity. Targets: supplied fictional cards and model outputs only. Time: Week 9 lesson 2. Permitted: discussion, manual prediction, offline fictional CSV counting. Excluded: networks, production servers, real accounts/data, scans, exploit execution, notices and public disclosure. Stop: unexpected personal information, scope ambiguity or proposal to access a real target. Contact: teacher. Data handling: supplied fictional files only; follow classroom handling rules. This is not permission for real penetration testing.
Red proposal: scenario/weakness, expected consequence, supplied evidence and boundaries.
Blue response: prevention, detection, response evidence, operational impact and limitation.
Shared finding: facts vs inference, priority/justification, proposed remediation, verification, residual risk. Mark proposed vs implemented. No claim that a paper pass proves deployment security.
